title: 聚焦離子束分析系統
summary: 從 30 keV 鎵離子在固體中的碰撞串級出發，理解聚焦離子束如何以奈米精度移除與沉積材料，再把離子源、靜電離子柱、SEM／FIB 雙束幾何、TEM 薄片的非晶化與鎵植入、束流與切削速率校正以及切片斷層重建整合成可交接的分析工程紀錄。
summaryEn: Start from the collision cascade of 30 keV gallium ions in a solid to see how a focused ion beam removes and deposits material with nanometre precision, then integrate the ion source, electrostatic ion column, SEM/FIB dual-beam geometry, amorphisation and gallium implantation in TEM lamellae, beam-current and milling-rate calibration and slice-and-view tomography into a transferable analytical engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「離子—固體作用與濺射產率」與「束流與光點尺寸的取捨」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield" and "Beam current versus probe size": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 離子—固體作用與濺射產率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」如何決定聚焦離子束分析系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms” determines the key performance of “Focused-ion-beam analysis systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 30 keV 的 Ga⁺ 質量 69.7 u，進入固體後主要以核阻擋把能量交給靶原子，形成一連串彈性碰撞的碰撞串級；靠近表面的原子若獲得超過表面結合能（矽約 4.7 eV）的向外動量便離開表面，這就是濺射。鎵在矽中的投射射程約 27 nm，橫向散布約 10 nm，所以切削的最小尺度與損傷深度都由此決定。濺射產率隨入射角上升、在約 75–80° 附近達到最大後下降，並隨材料、晶粒方向（通道效應）而變；同一次撞擊也放出離子誘發二次電子與二次離子，可用於成像與分析。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A 30 keV Ga⁺ ion of mass 69.7 u deposits its energy mainly through nuclear stopping, launching a collision cascade of elastic recoils; atoms near the surface that receive outward momentum above the surface binding energy (about 4.7 eV for silicon) leave the solid, which is sputtering. Gallium's projected range in silicon is about 27 nm with about 10 nm lateral straggle, setting both the smallest milling scale and the damage depth. Sputter yield rises with incidence angle to a maximum near 75–80° and then falls, and it varies with material and grain orientation through channelling; the same impacts emit ion-induced secondary electrons and secondary ions used for imaging and analysis. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設 30 keV Ga⁺ 正向入射矽的濺射產率 Y = 2.2 原子/離子，矽原子體積 Ω = 28.09/(2.329×6.022×10²³) cm³ ≈ 0.0200 nm³：每 nC 電荷移除體積 = (10⁻⁹/1.602×10⁻¹⁹) × 2.2 × 0.0200 nm³ ≈ 6.24×10⁹ × 0.044 nm³ ≈ 0.275 µm³/nC。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assuming a sputter yield Y = 2.2 atoms per ion for 30 keV Ga⁺ at normal incidence on silicon and an atomic volume Ω = 28.09/(2.329×6.022×10²³) cm³ ≈ 0.0200 nm³, the volume removed per nanocoulomb is (10⁻⁹/1.602×10⁻¹⁹) × 2.2 × 0.0200 nm³ ≈ 6.24×10⁹ × 0.044 nm³ ≈ 0.275 µm³/nC.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離子切削對任何材料、晶粒方向與入射角都以相同速率均勻移除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ion milling removes every material, grain orientation and incidence angle at the same uniform rate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A 30 keV Ga⁺ ion of mass 69.7 u deposits its energy mainly through nuclear stopping, launching a collision cascade of elastic recoils; atoms near the surface that receive outward momentum above the surface binding energy (about 4.7 eV for silicon) leave the solid, which is sputtering. Gallium's projected range in silicon is about 27 nm with about 10 nm lateral straggle, setting both the smallest milling scale and the damage depth.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：離子切削對任何材料、晶粒方向與入射角都以相同速率均勻移除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Ion milling removes every material, grain orientation and incidence angle at the same uniform rate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「離子—固體作用與濺射產率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield" is correct?
options: 離子切削對任何材料、晶粒方向與入射角都以相同速率均勻移除。
30 keV 的 Ga⁺ 質量 69.7 u，進入固體後主要以核阻擋把能量交給靶原子，形成一連串彈性碰撞的碰撞串級。
離子波長極短，所以聚焦離子束在任何束流下都能維持奈米級光點。
optionsEn: Ion milling removes every material, grain orientation and incidence angle at the same uniform rate.
A 30 keV Ga⁺ ion of mass 69.7 u deposits its energy mainly through nuclear stopping, launching a collision cascade of elastic recoils.
Because ion wavelengths are tiny, a focused ion beam keeps a nanometre spot at any current.
quiz.explanation: 30 keV 的 Ga⁺ 質量 69.7 u，進入固體後主要以核阻擋把能量交給靶原子，形成一連串彈性碰撞的碰撞串級；靠近表面的原子若獲得超過表面結合能（矽約 4.7 eV）的向外動量便離開表面，這就是濺射。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A 30 keV Ga⁺ ion of mass 69.7 u deposits its energy mainly through nuclear stopping, launching a collision cascade of elastic recoils; atoms near the surface that receive outward momentum above the surface binding energy (about 4.7 eV for silicon) leave the solid, which is sputtering. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 離子—固體作用與濺射產率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設 30 keV Ga⁺ 正向入射矽的濺射產率 Y = 2.2 原子/離子，矽原子體積 Ω = 28.09/(2.329×6.022×10²³) cm³ ≈ 0.0200 nm³：每 nC 電荷移除體積 = (10⁻⁹/1.602×10⁻¹⁹) × 2.2 × 0.0200 nm³ ≈ 6.24×10⁹ × 0.044 nm³ ≈ 0.275 µm³/nC。切一個 20 × 10 × 10 µm（2000 µm³）的截面方塊需 2000/0.275 ≈ 7270 nC，以 30 nA 約 243 s ≈ 4 分鐘（未計再沉積）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assuming a sputter yield Y = 2.2 atoms per ion for 30 keV Ga⁺ at normal incidence on silicon and an atomic volume Ω = 28.09/(2.329×6.022×10²³) cm³ ≈ 0.0200 nm³, the volume removed per nanocoulomb is (10⁻⁹/1.602×10⁻¹⁹) × 2.2 × 0.0200 nm³ ≈ 6.24×10⁹ × 0.044 nm³ ≈ 0.275 µm³/nC. A 20 × 10 × 10 µm (2000 µm³) cross-section box needs 2000/0.275 ≈ 7270 nC, about 243 s or 4 minutes at 30 nA before redeposition is counted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在矽晶片上以固定束流切一組劑量遞增的方塊，以傾斜 SEM 截面、AFM 或觸針輪廓儀量深度，換算 µm³/nC 並與上式比較；對實際關心的材料（銅、鎢、二氧化矽、光阻）重做同一組測試建立材料表，並在 0°、30°、60° 入射角各量一次確認角度依存性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mill a series of boxes of increasing dose on a silicon wafer at fixed current, measure their depth by tilted SEM cross-section, AFM or stylus profiler, convert to µm³/nC and compare with the estimate; repeat the series on the materials that matter (copper, tungsten, silicon dioxide, resist) to build a materials table, and measure at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to confirm the angular dependence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

光闌標示的束流值就是實際打到樣品上的束流。

steps.title: 離子—固體作用與濺射產率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在矽晶片上以固定束流切一組劑量遞增的方塊，以傾斜 SEM 截面、AFM 或觸針輪廓儀量深度，換算 µm³/nC 並與上式比較；對實際關心的材料（銅、鎢、二氧化矽、光阻）重做同一組測試建立材料表，並在 0°、30°、60° 入射角各量一次確認角度依存性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mill a series of boxes of increasing dose on a silicon wafer at fixed current, measure their depth by tilted SEM cross-section, AFM or stylus profiler, convert to µm³/nC and compare with the estimate; repeat the series on the materials that matter (copper, tungsten, silicon dioxide, resist) to build a materials table, and measure at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to confirm the angular dependence. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：在高深寬比溝槽中濺出的原子再沉積到側壁，方塊變成 V 形、有效切削速率下降，依時間估算的深度偏深；多晶銅因晶粒方向不同的通道效應使切削速率相差數倍，截面底部凹凸不平並在銅／介電層界面產生假的空洞。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: In a high-aspect-ratio trench sputtered atoms redeposit on the sidewalls, the box turns V-shaped and the effective rate falls, so time-based depth estimates run deep; in polycrystalline copper channelling makes milling rates differ several-fold between grain orientations, leaving a rough floor and false voids at copper/dielectric interfaces.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在矽晶片上以固定束流切一組劑量遞增的方塊，以傾斜 SEM 截面、AFM 或觸針輪廓儀量深度，換算 µm³/nC 並與上式比較；對實際關心的材料（銅、鎢、二氧化矽、光阻）重做同一組測試建立材料表，並在 0°、30°、60° 入射角各量一次確認角度依存性。
knowledge.textEn: Mill a series of boxes of increasing dose on a silicon wafer at fixed current, measure their depth by tilted SEM cross-section, AFM or stylus profiler, convert to µm³/nC and compare with the estimate; repeat the series on the materials that matter (copper, tungsten, silicon dioxide, resist) to build a materials table, and measure at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to confirm the angular dependence.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「離子—固體作用與濺射產率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield"?
options: 在矽晶片上以固定束流切一組劑量遞增的方塊，以傾斜 SEM 截面、AFM 或觸針輪廓儀量深度，換算 µm³/nC 並與上式比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
切片厚度就等於設定的步距，不需要另外量測。
optionsEn: Mill a series of boxes of increasing dose on a silicon wafer at fixed current, measure their depth by tilted SEM cross-section, AFM or stylus profiler, convert to µm³/nC and compare with the estimate.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Slice thickness equals the programmed step and needs no separate measurement.
quiz.explanation: 在矽晶片上以固定束流切一組劑量遞增的方塊，以傾斜 SEM 截面、AFM 或觸針輪廓儀量深度，換算 µm³/nC 並與上式比較；對實際關心的材料（銅、鎢、二氧化矽、光阻）重做同一組測試建立材料表，並在 0°、30°、60° 入射角各量一次確認角度依存性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mill a series of boxes of increasing dose on a silicon wafer at fixed current, measure their depth by tilted SEM cross-section, AFM or stylus profiler, convert to µm³/nC and compare with the estimate; repeat the series on the materials that matter (copper, tungsten, silicon dioxide, resist) to build a materials table, and measure at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to confirm the angular dependence. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 離子—固體作用與濺射產率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 在高深寬比溝槽中濺出的原子再沉積到側壁，方塊變成 V 形、有效切削速率下降，依時間估算的深度偏深；多晶銅因晶粒方向不同的通道效應使切削速率相差數倍，截面底部凹凸不平並在銅／介電層界面產生假的空洞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: In a high-aspect-ratio trench sputtered atoms redeposit on the sidewalls, the box turns V-shaped and the effective rate falls, so time-based depth estimates run deep; in polycrystalline copper channelling makes milling rates differ several-fold between grain orientations, leaving a rough floor and false voids at copper/dielectric interfaces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：濺射產率隨入射角上升、在約 75–80° 附近達到最大後下降，並隨材料、晶粒方向（通道效應）而變；同一次撞擊也放出離子誘發二次電子與二次離子，可用於成像與分析。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sputter yield rises with incidence angle to a maximum near 75–80° and then falls, and it varies with material and grain orientation through channelling; the same impacts emit ion-induced secondary electrons and secondary ions used for imaging and analysis.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「離子切削對任何材料、晶粒方向與入射角都以相同速率均勻移除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Ion milling removes every material, grain orientation and incidence angle at the same uniform rate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

quiz.questionEn: When "Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.title: 束流與光點尺寸的取捨：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Beam current versus probe size: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束限光闌與離子探針光點」如何決定聚焦離子束分析系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot” determines the key performance of “Focused-ion-beam analysis systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 30 keV 鎵離子的德布羅意波長只有約 0.02 pm，繞射可以忽略；限制光點的是離子源的虛像尺寸、色差與球差。液態金屬離子源的能量散布約 5 eV，在小束流時色差主導，色差盤 d_c = C_c·α·ΔE/E 與收斂半角 α 成正比，而束流 I = π·α²·(dI/dΩ) 與 α² 成正比，所以光點約隨 √I 成長；到 nA 等級時球差與源像放大接手，光點擴大到數百 nm。工程上以一排不同孔徑的束限光闌在「快速移除」與「精細修整」之間切換，氙電漿源則以較低亮度換取 µA 等級的束流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束限光闌與離子探針光點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The de Broglie wavelength of a 30 keV gallium ion is only about 0.02 pm, so diffraction is negligible; the probe is limited by the virtual source size and by chromatic and spherical aberration. A liquid-metal ion source has an energy spread of about 5 eV, so chromatic aberration dominates at small currents: the chromatic disc d_c = C_c·α·ΔE/E grows linearly with the convergence half-angle α while the current I = π·α²·(dI/dΩ) grows with α², so the spot grows roughly as √I; at nanoampere currents spherical aberration and source magnification take over and spots reach hundreds of nanometres. A strip of beam-defining apertures switches between fast removal and fine polishing, while a xenon plasma source trades lower brightness for microampere currents. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設角電流密度 dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr、色差係數 C_c = 60 mm、ΔE = 5 eV、E = 30 keV：α = 0.3 mrad 時 I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA，d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm；α = 1 mrad 時 I ≈ 63 pA、d_c = 10 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assuming an angular intensity dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr, chromatic coefficient C_c = 60 mm, ΔE = 5 eV and E = 30 keV: at α = 0.3 mrad, I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA and d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm; at α = 1 mrad, I ≈ 63 pA and d_c = 10 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「離子波長極短，所以聚焦離子束在任何束流下都能維持奈米級光點。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because ion wavelengths are tiny, a focused ion beam keeps a nanometre spot at any current." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束限光闌與離子探針光點」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 束流與光點尺寸的取捨

knowledge.textEn: The de Broglie wavelength of a 30 keV gallium ion is only about 0.02 pm, so diffraction is negligible; the probe is limited by the virtual source size and by chromatic and spherical aberration. A liquid-metal ion source has an energy spread of about 5 eV, so chromatic aberration dominates at small currents: the chromatic disc d_c = C_c·α·ΔE/E grows linearly with the convergence half-angle α while the current I = π·α²·(dI/dΩ) grows with α², so the spot grows roughly as √I; at nanoampere currents spherical aberration and source magnification take over and spots reach hundreds of nanometres.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：離子波長極短，所以聚焦離子束在任何束流下都能維持奈米級光點。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「束流與光點尺寸的取捨」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Beam current versus probe size" is correct?
options: 離子波長極短，所以聚焦離子束在任何束流下都能維持奈米級光點。
FIB 的離子柱和 SEM 一樣使用磁透鏡聚焦。
30 keV 鎵離子的德布羅意波長只有約 0.02 pm，繞射可以忽略；限制光點的是離子源的虛像尺寸、色差與球差。
optionsEn: Because ion wavelengths are tiny, a focused ion beam keeps a nanometre spot at any current.
An FIB ion column focuses with magnetic lenses just like an SEM.
The de Broglie wavelength of a 30 keV gallium ion is only about 0.02 pm, so diffraction is negligible.
quiz.explanation: 30 keV 鎵離子的德布羅意波長只有約 0.02 pm，繞射可以忽略；限制光點的是離子源的虛像尺寸、色差與球差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The de Broglie wavelength of a 30 keV gallium ion is only about 0.02 pm, so diffraction is negligible; the probe is limited by the virtual source size and by chromatic and spherical aberration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 束流與光點尺寸的取捨：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Beam current versus probe size: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束限光闌與離子探針光點」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設角電流密度 dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr、色差係數 C_c = 60 mm、ΔE = 5 eV、E = 30 keV：α = 0.3 mrad 時 I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA，d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm；α = 1 mrad 時 I ≈ 63 pA、d_c = 10 nm。束流多 11 倍，色差盤大 3.3 倍，符合 d ∝ √I。若要以 3 nm 光點切 1 µm³ 需 3.6 nC，在 5.7 pA 要 10.5 分鐘，因此粗切與精修必須分開。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assuming an angular intensity dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr, chromatic coefficient C_c = 60 mm, ΔE = 5 eV and E = 30 keV: at α = 0.3 mrad, I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA and d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm; at α = 1 mrad, I ≈ 63 pA and d_c = 10 nm. Eleven times the current costs 3.3 times the chromatic disc, consistent with d ∝ √I. Removing 1 µm³ with the 3 nm probe needs 3.6 nC, or 10.5 minutes at 5.7 pA, which is why roughing and polishing are separated. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每個光闌以法拉第杯量實際束流，並在碳上錫球或金顆粒樣品以離子誘發二次電子影像量 20–80% 邊緣寬度，畫出光點對束流的對數圖確認小束流段斜率接近 0.5；另以短時間定點照射薄膜，量燒出孔洞的直徑與圓度，檢查光點是否有拖尾或像散。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the real current of every aperture with a Faraday cup and the 20–80% edge width in ion-induced secondary-electron images of tin spheres on carbon or gold particles, plotting probe size against current on log axes to confirm a slope near 0.5 at low current; also dwell the stationary beam briefly on a thin film and measure the diameter and roundness of the resulting hole to check for beam tails or astigmatism.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 假設角電流密度 dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr、色差係數 C_c = 60 mm、ΔE = 5 eV、E = 30 keV：α = 0.3 mrad 時 I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA，d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm；α = 1 mrad 時 I ≈ 63 pA、d_c = 10 nm。束流多 11 倍，色差盤大 3.3 倍，符合 d ∝ √I。若要以 3 nm 光點切 1 µm³ 需 3.6 nC，在 5.7 pA 要 10.5 分鐘，因此粗切與精修必須分開。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming an angular intensity dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr, chromatic coefficient C_c = 60 mm, ΔE = 5 eV and E = 30 keV: at α = 0.3 mrad, I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA and d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm; at α = 1 mrad, I ≈ 63 pA and d_c = 10 nm. Eleven times the current costs 3.3 times the chromatic disc, consistent with d ∝ √I. Removing 1 µm³ with the 3 nm probe needs 3.6 nC, or 10.5 minutes at 5.7 pA, which is why roughing and polishing are separated.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「束流與光點尺寸的取捨」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Beam current versus probe size", which statement holds?
options: 假設角電流密度 dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr、色差係數 C_c = 60 mm、ΔE = 5 eV、E = 30 keV：α = 0.3 mrad 時 I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA，d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm。
薄片越薄越好，表面損傷層對 TEM 分析沒有影響。
切片厚度就等於設定的步距，不需要另外量測。
optionsEn: Assuming an angular intensity dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr, chromatic coefficient C_c = 60 mm, ΔE = 5 eV and E = 30 keV: at α = 0.3 mrad, I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA and d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm.
The thinner the lamella the better; surface damage layers do not affect TEM analysis.
Slice thickness equals the programmed step and needs no separate measurement.
quiz.explanation: 假設角電流密度 dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr、色差係數 C_c = 60 mm、ΔE = 5 eV、E = 30 keV：α = 0.3 mrad 時 I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA，d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm；α = 1 mrad 時 I ≈ 63 pA、d_c = 10 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming an angular intensity dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr, chromatic coefficient C_c = 60 mm, ΔE = 5 eV and E = 30 keV: at α = 0.3 mrad, I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA and d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm; at α = 1 mrad, I ≈ 63 pA and d_c = 10 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 束流與光點尺寸的取捨：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Beam current versus probe size: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束限光闌與離子探針光點」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 每個光闌以法拉第杯量實際束流，並在碳上錫球或金顆粒樣品以離子誘發二次電子影像量 20–80% 邊緣寬度，畫出光點對束流的對數圖確認小束流段斜率接近 0.5；另以短時間定點照射薄膜，量燒出孔洞的直徑與圓度，檢查光點是否有拖尾或像散。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the real current of every aperture with a Faraday cup and the 20–80% edge width in ion-induced secondary-electron images of tin spheres on carbon or gold particles, plotting probe size against current on log axes to confirm a slope near 0.5 at low current; also dwell the stationary beam briefly on a thin film and measure the diameter and roundness of the resulting hole to check for beam tails or astigmatism. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：束限光闌長期被濺射磨成橢圓或邊緣變粗，光點帶出低強度的尾巴，在目標周圍數百 nm 內淺淺地切出光暈並植入鎵，使截面邊緣圓化、表層被非晶化；若用大束流做最後修整，損傷層與再沉積都遠超過要觀察的結構。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A beam-defining aperture sputtered into an ellipse or a ragged edge gives the probe a low-intensity tail that shallowly mills a halo hundreds of nanometres around the target and implants gallium there, rounding cross-section edges and amorphising the surface; using a high current for the final polish leaves damage and redeposition far larger than the structures to be examined.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每個光闌以法拉第杯量實際束流，並在碳上錫球或金顆粒樣品以離子誘發二次電子影像量 20–80% 邊緣寬度，畫出光點對束流的對數圖確認小束流段斜率接近 0.5；另以短時間定點照射薄膜，量燒出孔洞的直徑與圓度，檢查光點是否有拖尾或像散。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the real current of every aperture with a Faraday cup and the 20–80% edge width in ion-induced secondary-electron images of tin spheres on carbon or gold particles, plotting probe size against current on log axes to confirm a slope near 0.5 at low current; also dwell the stationary beam briefly on a thin film and measure the diameter and roundness of the resulting hole to check for beam tails or astigmatism.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「束流與光點尺寸的取捨」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Beam current versus probe size"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
每個光闌以法拉第杯量實際束流，並在碳上錫球或金顆粒樣品以離子誘發二次電子影像量 20–80% 邊緣寬度，畫出光點對束流的對數圖確認小束流段斜率接近 0.5。
FIB 在安裝時對準一次後，就會一直保持對準。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Measure the real current of every aperture with a Faraday cup and the 20–80% edge width in ion-induced secondary-electron images of tin spheres on carbon or gold particles, plotting probe size against current on log axes to confirm a slope near 0.5 at low current.
Once an FIB is aligned at installation it stays aligned forever.
quiz.explanation: 每個光闌以法拉第杯量實際束流，並在碳上錫球或金顆粒樣品以離子誘發二次電子影像量 20–80% 邊緣寬度，畫出光點對束流的對數圖確認小束流段斜率接近 0.5；另以短時間定點照射薄膜，量燒出孔洞的直徑與圓度，檢查光點是否有拖尾或像散。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the real current of every aperture with a Faraday cup and the 20–80% edge width in ion-induced secondary-electron images of tin spheres on carbon or gold particles, plotting probe size against current on log axes to confirm a slope near 0.5 at low current; also dwell the stationary beam briefly on a thin film and measure the diameter and roundness of the resulting hole to check for beam tails or astigmatism. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 束流與光點尺寸的取捨：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Beam current versus probe size: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「束限光闌與離子探針光點」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 束限光闌長期被濺射磨成橢圓或邊緣變粗，光點帶出低強度的尾巴，在目標周圍數百 nm 內淺淺地切出光暈並植入鎵，使截面邊緣圓化、表層被非晶化；若用大束流做最後修整，損傷層與再沉積都遠超過要觀察的結構。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A beam-defining aperture sputtered into an ellipse or a ragged edge gives the probe a low-intensity tail that shallowly mills a halo hundreds of nanometres around the target and implants gallium there, rounding cross-section edges and amorphising the surface; using a high current for the final polish leaves damage and redeposition far larger than the structures to be examined. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：工程上以一排不同孔徑的束限光闌在「快速移除」與「精細修整」之間切換，氙電漿源則以較低亮度換取 µA 等級的束流。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A strip of beam-defining apertures switches between fast removal and fine polishing, while a xenon plasma source trades lower brightness for microampere currents.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「離子波長極短，所以聚焦離子束在任何束流下都能維持奈米級光點。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because ion wavelengths are tiny, a focused ion beam keeps a nanometre spot at any current." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 束限光闌長期被濺射磨成橢圓或邊緣變粗，光點帶出低強度的尾巴，在目標周圍數百 nm 內淺淺地切出光暈並植入鎵，使截面邊緣圓化、表層被非晶化；若用大束流做最後修整，損傷層與再沉積都遠超過要觀察的結構。
knowledge.textEn: A beam-defining aperture sputtered into an ellipse or a ragged edge gives the probe a low-intensity tail that shallowly mills a halo hundreds of nanometres around the target and implants gallium there, rounding cross-section edges and amorphising the surface; using a high current for the final polish leaves damage and redeposition far larger than the structures to be examined.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「束流與光點尺寸的取捨」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Beam current versus probe size" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
FIB 的離子柱和 SEM 一樣使用磁透鏡聚焦。
束限光闌長期被濺射磨成橢圓或邊緣變粗，光點帶出低強度的尾巴，在目標周圍數百 nm 內淺淺地切出光暈並植入鎵，使截面邊緣圓化、表層被非晶化。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
An FIB ion column focuses with magnetic lenses just like an SEM.

A beam-defining aperture sputtered into an ellipse or a ragged edge gives the probe a low-intensity tail that shallowly mills a halo hundreds of nanometres around the target and implants gallium there, rounding cross-section edges and amorphising the surface.
quiz.explanation: 束限光闌長期被濺射磨成橢圓或邊緣變粗，光點帶出低強度的尾巴，在目標周圍數百 nm 內淺淺地切出光暈並植入鎵，使截面邊緣圓化、表層被非晶化；若用大束流做最後修整，損傷層與再沉積都遠超過要觀察的結構。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A beam-defining aperture sputtered into an ellipse or a ragged edge gives the probe a low-intensity tail that shallowly mills a halo hundreds of nanometres around the target and implants gallium there, rounding cross-section edges and amorphising the surface; using a high current for the final polish leaves damage and redeposition far larger than the structures to be examined. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
